title: Resend free plan starts failing with daily_quota_exceeded well before 100 sends
symptoms: 429 daily_quota_exceeded: You have exceeded your daily email sending quota.
Fewer than 100 API calls made today
Quota resets at midnight UTC, not 24 hours after the first send
cause: On the Free plan every to, cc, and bcc recipient counts as one email, received emails count too, and the 100 per day quota runs on the UTC calendar day.
fix: Count recipients, not API calls, read the x-resend-daily-quota header, and move to a paid plan before production traffic.
affected: Resend Free plan (100 per day, 3,000 per month), as of 2026-10
